plain: Either of us can end this agreement by giving 30 days' written notice.
legal: Either Party may terminate this Agreement by giving the other Party not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice.

plain: We can end the contract right away if you break it and don't fix it within 14 days.
legal: The Company may terminate this Agreement with immediate effect if the other Party commits a breach hereof and fails to remedy such breach within fourteen (14) days of being notified thereof.

plain: This agreement lasts for one year.
legal: This Agreement shall remain in force for a term of one (1) year.

plain: The contract renews automatically each year unless someone cancels.
legal: This Agreement shall renew automatically for successive one (1) year terms unless terminated by either Party.

plain: To stop the auto-renewal, tell us at least 60 days before the end date.
legal: To prevent automatic renewal, a Party shall give written notice of non-renewal not less than sixty (60) days before the expiry of the then-current term.

plain: If either company goes bankrupt, the other can cancel the contract.
legal: Either Party may terminate this Agreement forthwith if the other Party becomes insolvent or is declared bankrupt.

plain: When the contract ends, you have to give back all our stuff.
legal: Upon termination of this Agreement, the Client shall return to the Company all property belonging to the Company.

plain: Ending the contract doesn't cancel money that's already owed.
legal: Termination of this Agreement shall not relieve either Party of any obligation to pay sums accrued prior to the date of termination.

plain: The confidentiality rules still apply after the contract ends.
legal: The confidentiality obligations set forth herein shall survive the termination or expiry of this Agreement.

plain: You can cancel within the first 7 days and get all your money back.
legal: The Customer may cancel this Agreement within seven (7) days of its commencement and shall be entitled to a full refund.

plain: After you cancel, we'll delete your data within 90 days.
legal: Following cancellation, the Provider shall delete the Customer's data within ninety (90) days.

plain: We can't cancel just because we feel like it during the first year.
legal: The Provider shall not terminate this Agreement for convenience during the first (1st) year of the term.

plain: If you cancel early, you'll pay a fee equal to 2 months of service.
legal: In the event of early termination by the Customer, the Customer shall pay an early termination fee equal to two (2) months' service fees.

plain: Notice of termination must be in writing and signed.
legal: Any notice of termination shall be made in writing and duly signed.

plain: The lease ends on June 30, 2027.
legal: The term of the Lease shall expire on June 30, 2027.

plain: Either side can walk away if the deal isn't approved by the board by September 1.
legal: Either Party may terminate this Agreement if the transaction has not received board approval by September 1.

plain: If we stop providing the service, we'll refund you for the unused part.
legal: If the Provider discontinues the Service, the Provider shall refund the Customer on a pro rata basis for the unused portion of the prepaid term.

plain: You can end your membership at any time from your account page.
legal: The Member may terminate the membership at any time through the Member's account settings.

plain: Cancelling doesn't give you a refund for the current month.
legal: Cancellation shall not entitle the Member to a refund of fees paid for the current month.

plain: We can suspend your account if you use it for anything illegal.
legal: The Provider may suspend the User's account if the account is used for any unlawful purpose.

plain: Before ending the contract, we'll both try to sort out the problem for 30 days.
legal: Prior to any termination, the Parties shall attempt in good faith to resolve the matter for a period of thirty (30) days.

plain: When this agreement ends, any licenses we gave you end too.
legal: Upon termination of this Agreement, all licenses granted hereunder shall terminate automatically.

plain: You must stop using the software once the contract is over.
legal: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee shall cease all use of the Software.

plain: Within 10 days after the end, send us written confirmation that you've destroyed our files.
legal: Within ten (10) days following termination, the Recipient shall provide written certification that all files belonging to the Disclosing Party have been destroyed.

plain: If you don't use the service for 12 months, we may close your account.
legal: The Provider may close any account that remains inactive for a period of twelve (12) consecutive months.

plain: We'll warn you 30 days before closing an inactive account.
legal: The Provider shall give not less than thirty (30) days' notice prior to closing an inactive account.

plain: Termination is the only remedy if the service is down too often.
legal: Termination shall be the Customer's sole and exclusive remedy for repeated failure to meet the availability commitment.

plain: Either party can cancel if the other one is stopped from performing for more than 60 days by events outside their control.
legal: Either Party may terminate this Agreement if the other Party is prevented from performing its obligations by events beyond its reasonable control for more than sixty (60) days.

plain: The contractor can quit with 2 weeks' notice.
legal: The Contractor may terminate this engagement by giving two (2) weeks' written notice.

plain: If you end the contract, you still pay for work we've already done.
legal: Upon any termination by the Client, the Client shall pay for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination.

plain: The trial period is 14 days, after which you'll be billed unless you cancel.
legal: The trial period shall be fourteen (14) days, upon the expiry of which the Customer shall be billed unless the Customer has cancelled.

plain: We can end this deal if you're bought by one of our competitors.
legal: The Company may terminate this Agreement if the other Party undergoes a change of control in favor of a competitor of the Company.

plain: No one can end the agreement in the first 6 months except for a serious breach.
legal: Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the first six (6) months of the term, except in the event of a material breach.

plain: We'll keep backups for 30 days after you leave in case you want to come back.
legal: The Provider shall retain backups of the Customer's data for thirty (30) days following termination to permit reactivation of the account.

plain: Ending the contract won't affect any rights either of us already had.
legal: Termination of this Agreement shall be without prejudice to any rights or remedies accrued by either Party as at the date of termination.

plain: If you cancel within 48 hours of booking, there's no charge.
legal: No charge shall apply to any cancellation made within forty-eight (48) hours of booking.

plain: The agreement starts on the day both parties sign it.
legal: This Agreement shall come into effect on the date on which it has been signed by both Parties.

plain: The employer may end the job during the probation period with one week's notice.
legal: During the probationary period, the Employer may terminate the employment by giving one (1) week's notice.

plain: You can't transfer the remaining months of your plan to someone else.
legal: The Customer shall not transfer the unexpired portion of the plan to any third party.

plain: We may end the contract if you fail to pay twice in a row.
legal: The Provider may terminate this Agreement if the Customer fails to make two (2) consecutive payments when due.

plain: Once the project is delivered and accepted, this agreement is finished.
legal: This Agreement shall terminate upon delivery and acceptance of the Project.

plain: Either party may end the partnership if the other dies or becomes unable to work.
legal: Either Party may terminate the partnership upon the death or permanent incapacity of the other Party.

plain: You have to tell us by email if you want to cancel; phone calls don't count.
legal: Any notice of cancellation shall be given by email, and notice given by telephone shall not be valid.

plain: The service ends at midnight on the last day of your billing period.
legal: The Service shall terminate at midnight on the final day of the Customer's billing period.

plain: If the contract is cancelled, both sides keep the right to sue for earlier breaches.
legal: Termination of this Agreement shall not affect either Party's right to bring a claim in respect of any breach occurring prior to termination.

plain: We may end your subscription without notice if you're abusive to our staff.
legal: The Provider may terminate the subscription without notice in the event that the Customer engages in abusive conduct toward the Provider's personnel.

plain: You'll get a final invoice within 15 days of cancellation.
legal: The Provider shall issue a final invoice within fifteen (15) days of cancellation.

plain: Unless renewed, the offer expires on December 31.
legal: Unless renewed, this offer shall expire on December 31.

plain: You can switch to a cheaper plan only at renewal time.
legal: The Customer may downgrade to a lower-priced plan only upon renewal of the subscription.

plain: If the law changes and makes this contract illegal, either side can end it.
legal: Either Party may terminate this Agreement if any change in applicable law renders its performance unlawful.
